attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Examiners of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by APA or its sponsors, ABPP specialty academies, WV Psychological Association, WV Association of Professional Psychologists, NASP and affiliated regional organizations, WV School Psychologists Association are automatically accepted; at least 50% must come from these. Remainder: expert presentations, APA-approved self-study, own presentations (max 6), publications (max 6), grand rounds, graduate psychology courses
rules.audit_note: Documentary evidence of CE must be presented with each renewal application.

topics.who: All license holders and supervisees: ethics
Psychologists: mental health conditions common to veterans and families (incl. suicide risk screening, PTSD, family counseling needs)

rules.notes: Licenses dated quarterly and expire 2 years after issue. Applies also to supervised psychologists. Dually licensed (psychology + school psychology) may use 20 hours for both, with at least 3 hours in each area.
